title: FairAgent: Democratizing Fairness-Aware Machine Learning with LLM-Powered Agents
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on demographic and socioeconomic attributes like age, sex, and race in fairness-aware machine learning.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
